name: suede-analytics
description: Suede-owned measurement discipline for tracking plans, event and conversion instrumentation, UTM and campaign-parameter hygiene, and verification of what actually fires. Use when setting up, auditing, or repairing analytics across web, product, paid, and lifecycle surfaces. NOT FOR: experiment design or significance decisions (use suede-ab-testing), campaign optimization (use suede-ads), attribution models, model comparison, or cross-tool reconciliation (use suede-attribution), or revenue-proces
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一套分析埋点与测量规范，用于搭建、审计或修复网站、产品、广告及用户生命周期中的事件、转化和活动参数追踪。
